results.overview: The Tele-serial BHARAGHAR revolves around a family and their various tenants. Based on the relationships between the house owner’s family and the families of the various tenants, the plot of BHARAGHAR is mainly comic and also encompasses the lives of a few neighbours. The different plots are actually a broader reflection of the urban Assamese society. Crisp dialogues and stand-out performances by the cast of the tele-serial has made it one of the most-watched TV serial in the history of Assamese television. Every episode is conceived with a view to providing viewers wholesome entertainment.
results.name: Bharaghar

results.overview:
100 Questions is an American situation comedy series which premiered on NBC on May 27, 2010. In May 2009 the network announced that the show would debut midseason in March 2010 on Tuesday nights at 9:30 pm, after NBC's coverage of the 2010 Winter Olympics was completed. However the show was later pushed back to debut on May 27, 2010, with the episode order reduced from thirteen to six. 100 Questions is produced by Universal Media Studios, with executive producers Christopher Moynihan, Kelly Kulchak, Ron West, and Michelle Nader.

The cancellation of 100 Questions was announced on July 8, 2010.
results.name: 100 Questions

results.overview: The Nurses is a serialized primetime medical drama which aired on CBS from September 27, 1962 to May 11, 1965. It was originally called The Nurses when it premiered in 1962; for the second season, the title was expanded to The Doctors and the Nurses and it ran until 1965, when it was transformed into a half-hour daytime soap opera. The soap opera, also called The Nurses, ran on ABC from 1965 to 1967.
results.name: The Nurses

results.overview:
The Front Line was a BBC sitcom about two half-brothers of West Indian descent who shared a house, one brother, Malcolm, is a policeman, the other, Sheldon, is a dreadlocked Rastafarian. It was created by Alex Shearer, filmed in Bristol and Cardiff, and transmitted between 6 December 1984 and 17 January 1985. A pilot, On the Frontline, was broadcast in the 1970s.

The theme tune was written and performed by Black Roots, and the opening credits features the band performing the song.
results.name: The Front Line

results.overview:
Dick and the Duchess is a rare 1950s CBS situation comedy shot and set in London; it was one of the earliest of filmed television series in the UK.

A multinational insurance company stationed American Dick Starrett in London as an investigator and adjuster. His wife, Jane, daughter of an English earl, and her family were less than enchanted with her marriage to a commoner — and an American at that. Jane feels that she had been 'Americanised' by movie and television crime stories enough to be a detective, so she often tries to help with Dick's investigations, although she usually causes more problems by doing so.
results.name: Dick and the Duchess

results.overview: Nobody's Perfect is an American situation comedy television series, broadcast on ABC, about a bumbling police detective; it aired for two months in 1980, for a total of eight episodes. In the UK this program is known as Hart of the Yard. It was broadcast in France only once in 1984 on TF1 under the name Cher Inspecteur. In Germany it was known as Hart auf Hart.
results.name: Nobody's Perfect

results.overview:
The Red Buttons Show premiered on the CBS television network in 1952, and ran for two years on that network, then moved to NBC for the final 1954-55 season.

Red's catch phrase from the show, "Strange things are happening!" entered the national vocabulary briefly in the mid-1950s.
results.name: The Red Buttons Show

results.overview: Kelas Internasional (English: International Class) is an Indonesian sitcom based on the 1970s British sitcom Mind Your Language. It revolves around someone who teaches a Bahasa Indonesia class composing of students from many different countries. It is aired every day at 5:00 P.M. It has been aired in three seasons, the first from 18 June 2015 to 16 March 2016, the second from 28 March 2016 to 19 August 2016, and the third since 22 August 2016 to 17 February 2017.

results.overview: Nishina, Maya, Shiro, and Aoi are four good friends in their second year of high school with good looks but disappointing personalities. The four who decided that they will never fall in love, formed their own club, known as the "Muda-bu" (Useless Club), which focuses on researching silly themes and uploading them on social media. One day, they decided to do an experiment from a manga that says, "If you run with a piece of bread in your mouth and bump into someone, you will fall in love". While trying to conduct the experiment, they accidentally bumped into someone while having a piece of bread in the mouth.

omdb.Title: Sex and the City
omdb.Actors: Sarah Jessica Parker, Kim Cattrall, Kristin Davis
omdb.Plot: A series following the lives of four female friends in in New York City. Though they are all career women, their respective professional lives and outlook in life tends to be very different. Carrie Bradshaw is a newspaper columnist and a fashion enthusiast. Her column regularly offers commentary on modern relationships, dating, and friendship, and gains for her a reputation as a celebrity in her own right. Carrie has a habit of overspending on designer shoes, experiencing significant financial strain at various points. She maintains an on-again-off-again romantic relationship with the businessman "Mr. Big" (his nickname) for most of the series. Charlotte York is an art gallery executive, art dealer, and art historian who had a privileged upbringing in Connecticut. She tends to have more idealistic and conservative views than her friends, and her love life is a long-term search for the "knight in shining armor" . She is Episcopalian for most of the series, but her love interests tend to be Jewish men. She eventually converts to Judaism. Miranda Hobbes is a Harvard-educated lawyer from Philadelphia. She tends to be pragmatic and cynical in both her work environment and her romantic relationships. An unplanned pregnancy eventually has her adjusting to motherhood, which she finds difficult to balance with her demanding career. Samantha Jones is the oldest member of the group, and had had a successful public relations executive. She is assertive, independent, and unapologetically open about her sexuality. For most of her life, Samantha preferred sex without emotional involvement. She struggles with the idea of long-term relationships, and she does not want to appear emotionally vulnerable. She is somewhat surprised that she has genuine feelings for some of her lovers, and that some of them feel genuine affection or loyalty for her.
omdb.Awards: Won 7 Primetime Emmys. 48 wins & 166 nominations total
